character: High-speed street circuit down the Las Vegas Strip, run at night in cold desert-winter track temperatures. Very long straights favour low drag; low ambient and track temperature make tyre warm-up and braking stability a persistent challenge.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/las-vegas/circuit — deliberately generic Turn-N labels (see comment above)
notes: Corner numbers kept generic — this is a newer addition to the calendar with limited independently-verified corner-name sourcing; only the well-documented circuit character (long Strip straight, very high top speed, cold-track grip) is asserted with confidence.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: heavy-braking corner off the main straight
corners.technique: Brake early to account for cold-track grip levels, late apex
corners.trap: Locking a cold front tyre under braking

corners.name: Turn 5
corners.technique: Commit smoothly, respect the reduced grip from low track temperature
corners.trap: Overdriving the entry on a cold tyre and sliding wide

corners.name: Turn 12-14
corners.technique: Patient, precise inputs through the tighter sequence
corners.trap: Wall contact from an overly ambitious line in the tight section

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.type: corner onto the long Strip straight
corners.technique: Clean exit is critical — feeds the longest straight on the lap
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs significant time down the following straight
